instruction: Pull over beside the motorcyclist on the left.
paraphrases: Stop next to the nearby motorbike rider on the left.|Park beside the motorcyclist on the left.

instruction: Pass the grey van ahead, then stop near the white SUV on the right.
paraphrases: Go past the grey van in front and pull over by the white SUV on the right.|After the grey van, stop beside the right-hand white SUV.

instruction: Stop beside the white SUV on the left—correction, stop behind the silver sedan ahead.
paraphrases: Take the white SUV on the left—rather, the silver sedan in front.|Stop behind the silver sedan ahead, not the white SUV on the left.

instruction: Pass the partially visible car at the left edge, then stop near the dark sedan ahead on the right.
paraphrases: Go past the cut-off car on the left and stop by the dark sedan ahead.|After the partly visible left-edge car, pull over near the dark sedan on the right.
